mal:area.name: COM
mal:area.mal:documentation: The id of an object shall not use the value of '0' for actual object instances as this is the wildcard value.
The related field of an object shall not use the value of '0' as this is the wildcard value.
The id of the source field of an object shall not use the value of '0' as this is the wildcard value.
If the MAL data type specification is being used, then the body of an object shall be a concrete type.
If the MAL data type specification is being used, then the body of an object shall not be an abstract Attribute.
If the MAL data type specification is being used, then the body of an object shall not be a list.

mal:service.name: Archive
mal:service.comment: The Archive service provides a basic CRUD interface to a standard archiving function. It allows objects to be stored, retrieved, updated, deleted, and queried.

mal:invokeIP.name: retrieve
mal:invokeIP.comment: The retrieve operation retrieves a set of objects identified by their id.
mal:invokeIP.mal:documentation: If the ids field contains the wildcard value '0', then the service provider shall match all object instances.
The RESPONSE message shall contain the set of matched objects.

The service provider shall order the objBodies identically to the metadata list, unless no body for the object is declared in the service specification, in which case a NULL replaces the complete list.
The service provider shall include one entry in both metadata and objBodies for each matched object.
If no objects have been matched, then the service provider shall return a RESPONSE message with NULL for both metadata and objBodies.
The service provider may return objects in any implementation-specific order.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the object to be retrieved.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the object to be retrieved.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids to be retrieved.

mal:field.name: metadata
mal:field.comment: The metadata of the matched objects.

mal:field.name: objBodies
mal:field.comment: The bodies of the matched objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: When any field of the object type contains the wildcard value '0', or the domain contains the wildcard value '*'.
When one or more of the requested objects specified in the operation do not exist in the archive.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the error values.

mal:progressIP.name: query
mal:progressIP.comment: The query operation allows a consumer to query the archive for objects matching the supplied filter criteria, returning their metadata and optionally their bodies. Results are delivered as a stream of UPDATE messages to accommodate potentially large result sets.
mal:progressIP.mal:documentation: Each part of the objType field may use the wildcard value of '0'.
If the queryFilter field is NULL, then the service provider shall not apply a query filter.
The archiveQuery field may contain the wildcard value of NULL on any of its fields.
If the archiveQuery field contains an end time but no start time, then the service provider shall return the single object whose timestamp is closest to, but not greater than, the end time.
The end time field of the archiveQuery may specify a time in the future.
Each UPDATE message shall contain the matched objects.
If the objType field of the PROGRESS message contains a wildcard, then the service provider shall include the ObjectType of each matched object in the UPDATE message.
If the objType field of the PROGRESS message does not contain a wildcard, then the objType field in each UPDATE message shall be NULL.
The domain field in each UPDATE message shall contain the domain of the matched objects.
If multiple ObjectTypes or domains are matched, then the service provider may return multiple UPDATE messages.
In each UPDATE message, the objDetails and objBodies lists shall have one entry per matched object.
The objDetails field in each UPDATE message shall contain the ArchiveDetails of the matched objects.
If the returnBody field of the PROGRESS message is TRUE, then the objBodies field in each UPDATE message shall contain the bodies of the matched objects.
If the returnBody field of the PROGRESS message is NULL or FALSE, then the objBodies field in each UPDATE message shall be NULL.
The service provider shall sort the returned lists based on the sorting options specified in the archiveQuery field.
The service provider shall sort each domain/object type pair separately.
The service provider shall not apply sorting across domain/object type pairs.

If the field being sorted on contains a NULL value, or does not exist in the matched object due to a containing composite being NULL, then the service provider shall add those entries to the end of the returned list in the order that they were matched.
The final RESPONSE message shall be empty and signals to the consumer that all matched objects have been returned.
If no objects are matched, then the service provider shall send only the empty RESPONSE message with no preceding UPDATE messages.

mal:field.name: returnBody
mal:field.comment: Flag that defines if the body is to be returned.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the object to be returned.

mal:field.name: archiveQuery
mal:field.comment: The archive query to apply.

mal:field.name: queryFilter
mal:field.comment: The query filter to apply, or NULL if no filter is required.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the matched object.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the matched objects.

mal:field.name: objDetails
mal:field.comment: The archive details of the matched objects.

mal:field.name: objBodies
mal:field.comment: The bodies of the matched objects, or NULL if not requested.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the archiveQuery or queryFilter field contains an invalid value, such as when the sortFieldName does not reference a defined field.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A description of the invalid value.

mal:invokeIP.name: count
mal:invokeIP.comment: The count operation counts the set of objects matching a supplied query.
mal:invokeIP.mal:documentation: The service provider shall process the objType, archiveQuery, and queryFilter fields of the INVOKE message in the same way as the corresponding fields in the query operation.
The RESPONSE message shall contain the count of matched objects.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the object.

mal:field.name: archiveQuery
mal:field.comment: The archive query to apply.

mal:field.name: queryFilter
mal:field.comment: The query filter to apply, or NULL if no filter is required.

mal:field.name: count
mal:field.comment: The number of objects that match the provided criteria.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the archiveQuery or queryFilter field contains an invalid value, such as when the sortFieldName does not reference a defined field.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A description of the invalid value.

mal:requestIP.name: store
mal:requestIP.comment: The store operation stores new objects in the archive. When new objects are stored the archive service provider is capable of assigning an unused id for the objects being stored. The returned id should be used by the service provider for identifying the object instances to its consumer to ensure that only a single id is used for each object instance.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: If the id supplied in the archive details is '0', then the service provider shall assign a new and unused id.
The objDetails and objBodies lists shall be the same size, with one entry each per object to be stored.
If the type of the body of the object differs from the type declared in the relevant service specification, then the service provider should raise an INVALID error.
If any error occurs, then the service provider shall not store any objects.
If the returnIds field is TRUE, then the RESPONSE message shall contain the list of new ids.
If the returnIds field is FALSE, then the ids field shall be NULL.
The service provider shall order the ids list identically to the submitted objDetails list so that the returned ids can be mapped to the correct objects.

mal:field.name: returnIds
mal:field.comment: Flag that states if the ids are to be returned.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the objects to be stored.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the objects to be stored.

mal:field.name: objDetails
mal:field.comment: The list of archive details for the objects to be stored.

mal:field.name: objBodies
mal:field.comment: The list of object bodies to be stored.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids of the stored objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one or more of the objects being stored has supplied an id that is already in use in the archive.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating request list.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one or more of the objects being stored contains an invalid value: a wildcard value of '0' in the object type, a wildcard value of '*' in the domain, a value of '0', '*', or NULL in the timestamp or provider fields of the archive details, or mismatched objDetails and objBodies list sizes.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list.

mal:submitIP.name: update
mal:submitIP.comment: The update operation updates an object (or set of objects).
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: The service provider shall match objects using the id from the ArchiveDetails combined with the object type and domain from the SUBMIT message.
The service provider shall update the matched objects using the values from the ArchiveDetails structure.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the object.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the objects to be updated.

mal:field.name: objDetails
mal:field.comment: The list of archive details for the objects to be updated.

mal:field.name: objBodies
mal:field.comment: The list of updated object bodies.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one or more of the requested objects do not exist in the archive.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one or more of the objects being updated contains a wildcard value in the object type, domain, or id fields.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list.

mal:requestIP.name: delete
mal:requestIP.comment: The delete operation deletes an object (or set of objects).
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: If the ids field contains the wildcard value '0', then the service provider shall match all object instances of the specified type and domain.
The service provider shall delete the matched objects from the archive.
The RESPONSE message shall contain the list of ids of the deleted objects.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The type of the object.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the objects to be deleted.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The list of ids of the objects to be deleted.

mal:field.name: deletedIds
mal:field.comment: The ids of the deleted objects.

mal:errorRef.comment: When one or more of the explicitly requested objects do not exist in the archive.

mal:extraInformation.comment: A list of the indexes of the erroneous values from the originating list.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the objType field or the domain field contains a wildcard value.

mal:service.name: ArchiveSync
mal:service.comment: The ArchiveSync service allows a service consumer to synchronize the COM Archive with a service provider.

mal:requestIP.name: getTime
mal:requestIP.comment: The getTime operation allows a consumer to retrieve the current time and the time of the last synchronization from the provider.

mal:field.name: currentTime
mal:field.comment: The current time on the provider.

mal:field.name: lastSyncTime
mal:field.comment: The time of the last synchronization, or NULL if never synchronized.

mal:progressIP.name: retrieveRange
mal:progressIP.comment: The retrieveRange operation allows a consumer to retrieve COM archive objects within a specified time range. The response is streamed as a sequence of compressed chunks.

mal:field.name: from
mal:field.comment: The start time of the range to retrieve.

mal:field.name: until
mal:field.comment: The end time of the range to retrieve.

mal:field.name: objectTypes
mal:field.comment: The list of object types to retrieve, or NULL for all types.

mal:field.name: compression
mal:field.comment: The compression algorithm identifier, or NULL for no compression.

mal:field.name: interactionTicket
mal:field.comment: The ticket id assigned to this retrieval transaction.

mal:field.name: chunk
mal:field.comment: A chunk of the serialized archive data.

mal:field.name: index
mal:field.comment: The index of this chunk in the overall response.

mal:field.name: numberOfChunks
mal:field.comment: The total number of chunks in the response.

mal:progressIP.name: retrieveRangeAgain
mal:progressIP.comment: The retrieveRangeAgain operation allows a consumer to re-request chunks that were not received in a previous retrieveRange interaction.

mal:field.name: interactionTicket
mal:field.comment: The ticket id from the previous retrieveRange interaction.

mal:field.name: missingIndexes
mal:field.comment: The list of chunk indexes that were not received and need to be retransmitted.

mal:field.name: chunk
mal:field.comment: A chunk of the serialized archive data.

mal:field.name: index
mal:field.comment: The index of this chunk in the overall response.

mal:requestIP.name: getDictionary
mal:requestIP.comment: The getDictionary operation allows a consumer to retrieve dictionary words by their ids.

mal:field.name: wordIds
mal:field.comment: The list of word ids to retrieve from the dictionary.

mal:field.name: words
mal:field.comment: The list of words corresponding to the requested ids.

mal:submitIP.name: free
mal:submitIP.comment: The free operation allows a consumer to release a transaction after completing a retrieval.

mal:field.name: transactionTicket
mal:field.comment: The ticket id of the transaction to be released.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the provided transaction ticket does not match a known transaction.

com:objects.comment: The ArchiveSync service can store the last synchronizations information on the COM Archive.

mal:service.name: Directory
mal:service.comment: The Directory service allows providers to publish information about which services they provide and consumers to discover provider address and capability information. Service provider information is made available using the Directory service add operation and removed using the remove operation. The lookup operation provides the ability for consumers to query the directory service based on a filter such as required service capability. Finally, a provider may supply its set of service specification XML files when publishing its capabilities. This allows consumers that are able to process MO service XML files obtain the files for further processing. It is expected that this would be used to either ensure that no modifications have been made by a provider to a standard service or, in the case of a consumer that is able to dynamically interact with new service specifications, obtain the service specification to allow interaction with that new service.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The directory service shall provide the capability to:
  1. request provider details based on a filter;
  2. add new provider details;
  3. remove provider details;
  4. request the area XML for a certain MAL area.
A provider shall use the add operation to make available the set of services and the capabilities of those services that it offers.
The add operation shall take a Provider structure which defines the capabilities and addressing information of that provider.
A provider may offer multiple service addresses and bindings in order to support multiple message transports and encodings.
If a service has operations based on the PUB-SUB interaction pattern, then the Directory service shall hold two URIs for that service: the URI of the primary interface and the URI of the broker.
A Provider COM object shall represent a provider and its supported capabilities.
The Provider COM object body shall contain the provider details of the provider.
The service provider shall set the Provider COM object related link to NULL.
The service provider shall set the Provider COM object source link to NULL.
The add operation shall create the Provider object.
The provider of the Directory service shall populate the id for the Provider object.
If the implementation of the Directory service uses a COM archive, then the provider of the Directory service shall store all directory objects in the COM archive.

mal:requestIP.name: lookup
mal:requestIP.comment: The lookup operation retrieves the list of providers made available in the Directory service.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: A consumer shall send the lookup criteria to the provider for the providers intended to be retrieved.
The service provider shall combine the specified filters using AND logic.
The RESPONSE message shall contain the list of providers that match the requested criteria.
If no match is found, then the service provider shall return an empty list.
If the providerName field is NULL, then the service provider shall match all provider identifiers.
If the final identifier of the domain field of the filter is the wildcard '*', then the service provider shall search all sub-domains for matches.
If the domain field is NULL, then the service provider shall match all domains.
The service provider shall use the serviceId field to match against the ServiceId fields of the Provider of a specific provider.
If the serviceId field is NULL, then the service provider shall match all areas, services, and versions.
If the area field is the wildcard '0', then the service provider shall match all area names.
If the service field is the wildcard '0', then the service provider shall match all services.
If the version field is the wildcard '0', then the service provider shall match all area versions.
If the addressSchemeFilter field is not NULL, then the service provider shall only include service addresses whose URI starts with one of the listed scheme values in the RESPONSE message.

mal:field.name: filter
mal:field.comment: The lookup query filter to be used to match the providers.

mal:field.name: matchingProviders
mal:field.comment: The providers that matched the filter.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the domain field contains a wildcard value in any position other than the final identifier.

mal:requestIP.name: add
mal:requestIP.comment: The add operation adds a new or updates an existing entry in the list of providers held in the directory service.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: If the domain field of the newProviderDetails is empty or contains the wildcard '*', then the service provider shall return an INVALID error.
If the providerName field of the Provider structure is empty or contains the wildcard '*', then the service provider shall return an INVALID error.
If any area, service, or version field of a contained ServiceId structure contains '0', then the service provider shall return an INVALID error.
If an error occurs, then the service provider shall not make any changes.
If the providerName field of the Provider structure matches an existing Provider COM object, then the service provider shall update the existing details of that provider.
If the providerName field of the Provider structure does not match an existing Provider COM object, then the service provider shall create a new Provider COM object to represent the new provider.
The directory provider should store the created objects in the COM archive.
The service provider shall return the COM identifier of the Provider COM object representing the provider.

mal:field.name: newProviderDetails
mal:field.comment: The details of the provider to be added or updated in the Directory service.

mal:field.name: providerId
mal:field.comment: The id of the provider.

mal:errorRef.comment: When any submitted field value is invalid.

mal:submitIP.name: remove
mal:submitIP.comment: The remove operation removes an existing entry from the list of providers held in the Directory service. If no match is found for the withdraw request, then nothing is changed.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: If an error occurs, then the service provider shall not make any changes.
The service provider shall remove the matched provider from the directory service.

mal:field.name: providerId
mal:field.comment: The id of the provider to remove from the Directory service.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the supplied providerId does not match an existing Provider COM object.
When the supplied providerId is '0'.

mal:requestIP.name: getAreaXML
mal:requestIP.comment: The getAreaXML operation returns the list of XML files with the information about the area.

mal:field.name: filename
mal:field.comment: The filename of the XML file. The wildcard may be used to return all XML files.

mal:field.name: xmlFiles
mal:field.comment: The list of XML files.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the supplied filename is invalid.
When the requested XML file is not found.

com:objects.comment: The Provider object used by the Directory service.

com:archiveUsage.comment: The Directory service COM archive usage.

mal:service.name: Login
mal:service.comment: The Login service defines the primary mechanism for the submission of authentication credentials to a deployment-specific security system. It supports operations to allow a user to log in and log out. The returned authentication identifiers are used in the MAL message header to authenticate and authorise messages via Access Control.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The login service shall provide the capability:
  1. log in;
  2. log out.

mal:requestIP.name: login
mal:requestIP.comment: The login operation allows a user to log in to the system. A specific deployment may place limits on the number of concurrent logins for a user, and in that case will fail the login operation with the TOO_MANY error.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: If the authenticationId MAL header field of the REQUEST message is not NULL, then the service provider shall return an INVALID error.
The service provider shall check the authenticationId MAL header field before applying all other tests.
The consumer shall set the returned authId as the authenticationId MAL header field in all subsequent MAL messages.

mal:field.name: username
mal:field.comment: The username of the user.

mal:field.name: password
mal:field.comment: The password of the user.

mal:field.name: authId
mal:field.comment: The authentication identifier for the user.

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: The LoginInstance COM id created by the login operation.

mal:errorRef.comment: When the username is currently in use by another active session.
When the submitted username contains invalid values. No further information is provided as it may compromise security.
When the concurrent session limit for the username is exceeded.
When the username and password combination does not match a known user.

mal:submitIP.name: logout
mal:submitIP.comment: The logout operation allows a user to log out from the system. No information is passed in the message as the MAL authentication Id is enough to identify the login.
mal:submitIP.mal:documentation: The service provider shall identify the logged in user using the authenticationId MAL header field of the SUBMIT message.
The service provider shall not return any errors from this operation.

com:archiveUsage.comment: The Login service COM archive usage.

mal:service.name: Configuration
mal:service.comment: The Configuration service allows a service consumer to activate pre-defined configurations of a provider. The service uses COM objects to represent the configurations allowed by a provider.
mal:service.mal:documentation: The object body of the ConfigurationService COM object shall hold the service key that identifies the service it is a configuration of.
The ConfigurationService COM object related link shall link to the ConfigurationSet COM object that contains the objects that form the service configuration.
If the ConfigurationService represents a hard-coded configuration for a single service, then the service provider shall set the related link to NULL.
The object body of the ConfigurationProvider COM object shall hold an identifier to identify the provider configuration.
The ConfigurationProvider COM object related link shall link to the ConfigurationSet COM object that contains the objects that form the provider configuration.
If the ConfigurationProvider represents a hard-coded configuration for a provider, then the service provider shall set the related link to NULL.
The object body of the ConfigurationSet COM object shall hold a configuration object details structure that links to the objects that form the configuration.
The service provider shall set the ConfigurationSet COM object related link to NULL.

If the implementation of the Configuration service uses a COM archive, then the provider of the Configuration service shall store configuration definition objects (ConfigurationService, ConfigurationProvider, ConfigurationSet) in the COM archive.

If the implementation of the Configuration service uses a COM archive, then the provider of the relevant service shall store the COM objects that form the actual configuration definition details in the COM archive.

com:objects.comment: The ConfigurationService and ConfigurationProvider COM objects used by the Configuration service.

com:archiveUsage.comment: The Configuration service COM archive usage.

mal:composite.name: ObjectType
mal:composite.comment: The ObjectType structure uniquely identifies the type of an object. It is the combination of the area number, service number, area version, and service object type number. The combined parts are able to fit inside a MAL::Long (for implementations that prefer to index on a single numeric field rather than a structure).

mal:field.name: area
mal:field.comment: Area Number where the object type is defined. '0' is the wildcard value.

mal:field.name: service
mal:field.comment: Service Number of the service where the object type is defined. '0' is the wildcard value.

mal:field.name: version
mal:field.comment: Area Version of the service where the object type is defined. '0' is the wildcard value.

mal:field.name: number
mal:field.comment: The service specific object number. '0' is the wildcard value.

mal:composite.name: ObjectKey
mal:composite.comment: The ObjectKey structure uniquely identifies a COM object by combining its type, domain, and id.

mal:field.name: type
mal:field.comment: The fully qualified unique identifier of the type.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the object instance.

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: The unique id. '0' is the wildcard value.

mal:composite.name: ObjectKeys
mal:composite.comment: The ObjectKeys structure identifies a set of object instances for a single COM object type in a single domain.

mal:field.name: objType
mal:field.comment: The COM object type of the configuration objects.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the configuration objects.

mal:field.name: ids
mal:field.comment: The set of COM object ids that form this configuration set.

mal:composite.name: ObjectLinks
mal:composite.comment: The ObjectLinks type carries the extra information associated with an object instance, namely the related and source links.

mal:field.name: related
mal:field.comment: The id of a related object (e.g. the ActionDefinition that an Action uses). Service specific; the ObjectType of the related object is specified in the service specification. The related object is in the same domain as this object.

mal:field.name: source
mal:field.comment: An object which is at the origin of the object creation (e.g. the procedure from which an action was triggered).

mal:enumeration.name: ExpressionOperator
mal:enumeration.comment: The ExpressionOperator enumeration defines the set of possible expression operators.

mal:item.comment: Checks for greater than or equal to.
Checks for less than or equal to.
Case sensitive containment test (String types only).
Case insensitive containment test (String types only).

mal:composite.name: QueryFilter
mal:composite.comment: The base structure for archive filters.

mal:composite.name: ArchiveDetails
mal:composite.comment: The ArchiveDetails structure describes a single entry in an Archive.

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: The id of the archived object.

mal:field.name: links
mal:field.comment: The links of the Object.

mal:field.name: timestamp
mal:field.comment: The time the object was created.

mal:field.name: provider
mal:field.comment: The component that created the object (a component may be anything from an onboard equipment to a software process on the ground).

mal:composite.name: ArchiveQuery
mal:composite.comment: The ArchiveQuery structure is used to specify filters on the common parts of an object in an archive.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: Only the objects whose domain matches the provided domain will be returned. The domain field supports the wildcard value of '*' only in the last part of the domain. NULL indicates all domains are matched.

mal:field.name: provider
mal:field.comment: Optional provider. Only the objects whose provider URI matches the provided provider URI will be returned. If NULL then all values will be matched.

mal:field.name: related
mal:field.comment: The id of the related Object. Only the objects whose related Object matches the provided related Object will be returned unless the '0' wildcard value is supplied.

mal:field.name: source
mal:field.comment: Optional source. Only the objects whose source matches the provided source will be returned. The fields of the ObjectKey may contain the wildcard values ('0' for numeric fields, '*' for Identifier fields). If NULL then all values will be matched.

mal:field.name: startTime
mal:field.comment: Optional start time. Only the objects whose timestamp is equal or greater than the provided start time will be returned. NULL indicates no start time constraint is applied.

mal:field.name: endTime
mal:field.comment: Optional end time. Only the objects whose timestamp is equal or less than the provided end time will be returned. If NULL then no end time will be applied.

mal:field.name: sortOrder
mal:field.comment: Sort order for returned values. TRUE means ascending order, FALSE means descending order. NULL means no sorting is applied.

mal:field.name: sortFieldName
mal:field.comment: The name of the field in the object body (MAL::Composite) to sort against when sortOrder is not NULL. If the object body is not a composite but an Attribute or Enumeration, use an empty string ("") to sort on the value itself; Enumerations are sorted on their ordinal. NULL means objects are sorted on the COM object timestamp. The field naming convention follows CompositeFilter::fieldName. If the field points to a composite, list, abstract type (including Attribute), or Blob, no sorting is applied.

mal:composite.name: CompositeFilter
mal:composite.comment: The CompositeFilter allows an archive query to specify a filter based on the content of the body of an object if that body is specified using the MAL data type specification.

mal:field.name: fieldName
mal:field.comment: The name of the field in the object body (MAL::Composite) to match against. It is specified by referring to the name of the field. A field that does not exist in the Composite causes the filter to evaluate to FALSE. If the field is nested inside another Composite, it can be referenced by separating the field names by a '.' character; for example the field 'id' or the source of an ArchiveDetails composite would be referenced using "details.source.key.id". If the body is not a Composite but an Attribute or Enumeration then it can be referred to by using a blank ("") string value here. Accessing values from lists is not supported by this method.

mal:field.name: type
mal:field.comment: The type of the filter to apply.

mal:field.name: fieldValue
mal:field.comment: The comparison value; its type matches the type of the field being compared. NULL is invalid for CONTAINS, ICONTAINS, GREATER, GREATER_OR_EQUAL, LESS, and LESS_OR_EQUAL operators. For Enumeration fields, the value is a UInteger ordinal. For CONTAINS or ICONTAINS operators, the value is a String. Blob fields are only compatible with EQUAL and DIFFER operators.

mal:composite.name: CompositeFilterSet
mal:composite.comment: Contains a list of CompositeFilters that are AND'd together to form a more complex filter.

mal:field.name: filters
mal:field.comment: The list of filters to apply.

mal:composite.name: PaginationFilter
mal:composite.comment: The PaginationFilter allows an archive query to specify a filter based on the limit and offset of the query.

mal:field.name: limit
mal:field.comment: The limit for the page.

mal:field.name: offset
mal:field.comment: The offset for the page.

mal:composite.name: DictionaryEntry
mal:composite.comment: The DictionaryEntry structure describes a single entry of the Dictionary.

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: The id of the entry.

mal:field.name: string
mal:field.comment: The associated string.

mal:composite.name: Dictionary
mal:composite.comment: The Dictionary structure describes the Dictionary.

mal:field.name: entries
mal:field.comment: The entries of the dictionary.

mal:composite.name: CompactCOMObject
mal:composite.comment: The CompactCOMObject structure describes a COM Object whose string fields are encoded as dictionary identifiers.

mal:field.name: providerURI
mal:field.comment: Dictionary id for the provider URI of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: objectType
mal:field.comment: The Object Type of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: sourceLinkDomainId
mal:field.comment: Dictionary id for the source link domain of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: sourceLinkObjectType
mal:field.comment: The source link Object Type of the COM Object, encoded as a MAL::Long.

mal:field.name: sourceLinkId
mal:field.comment: The source link id of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: relatedLink
mal:field.comment: The related link of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: objectBody
mal:field.comment: The object body of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: The id of the COM Object.

mal:field.name: timestamp
mal:field.comment: The timestamp of the COM Object.

mal:composite.name: DomainizedCOMObjects
mal:composite.comment: The DomainizedCOMObjects structure groups a set of CompactCOMObjects that share the same domain.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: Dictionary id for the shared domain of these COM Objects.

mal:field.name: compactCOMObjects
mal:field.comment: A set of COM Objects.

mal:composite.name: LastSync
mal:composite.comment: The LastSync structure records information about a synchronization.

mal:field.name: providerURI
mal:field.comment: The provider URI.

mal:field.name: domainId
mal:field.comment: The domain.

mal:field.name: lastSyncTime
mal:field.comment: The time of the last synchronization.

mal:composite.name: ServiceCapability
mal:composite.comment: The ServiceCapability structure describes a service and the capabilities offered by a provider.

mal:field.name: serviceId
mal:field.comment: The area, service, and version fields.

mal:field.name: serviceProperties
mal:field.comment: Deployment-specific service properties.

mal:field.name: serviceAddresses
mal:field.comment: Service-specific address details that take precedence over the provider-level addresses. NULL if the provider-level addresses apply to this service.

mal:composite.name: AddressDetails
mal:composite.comment: The AddressDetails structure carries all information required by the Directory service about a provider URI.

mal:field.name: serviceURI
mal:field.comment: The Service URI for the physical location of this service. NULL for a shared data provider (Broker).

mal:field.name: brokerURI
mal:field.comment: The broker URI that identifies the physical location of the publish and subscribe interface. NULL if the service does not use publish and subscribe operations or if a shared broker is to be used.

mal:composite.name: Provider
mal:composite.comment: The Provider structure describes a provider of a service and its capabilities.

mal:field.name: id
mal:field.comment: The unique id of this provider entry.

mal:field.name: providerName
mal:field.comment: The name of this provider.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain of the provider.

mal:field.name: serviceCapabilities
mal:field.comment: The service capabilities supported by this provider.

mal:field.name: providerAddresses
mal:field.comment: List of addresses for all services of this provider unless service specific addresses are supplied in the serviceCapabilities field. If all address information is supplied in the serviceCapabilities field this list should be zero length.

mal:field.name: providerType
mal:field.comment: The type of this provider. NULL if the provider type is unknown or not set.

mal:composite.name: ServiceFilter
mal:composite.comment: The ServiceFilter structure specifies all criteria required by the Directory service for a service lookup. The field filters are AND'd together.

mal:field.name: providerName
mal:field.comment: The required provider. Can be NULL in which case matches all values.

mal:field.name: domain
mal:field.comment: The domain to query. Can be NULL in which case matches all values.

mal:field.name: serviceId
mal:field.comment: The service to filter on, values can be NULL which matches all values.

mal:field.name: addressSchemeFilter
mal:field.comment: URI scheme prefixes to match against service addresses (e.g. 'malspp', 'maltcp'). If NULL, all addresses are returned.

mal:composite.name: ConfigurationService
mal:composite.comment: The ConfigurationService composite holds service identification and its complete configuration data.

mal:field.name: serviceIdentifier
mal:field.comment: Identifier of the service.

mal:field.name: configObjects
mal:field.comment: The list of configuration objects.

mal:composite.name: ConfigurationProvider
mal:composite.comment: The ConfigurationProvider composite holds provider identification and its complete configuration data.

mal:field.name: providerIdentifier
mal:field.comment: Identifier of the provider.

mal:field.name: configObjects
mal:field.comment: The list of configuration objects.

mal:enumeration.name: NMFProviderType
mal:enumeration.comment: The NMFProviderType enumeration classifies the role of a provider registered in the Directory service.

mal:item.comment: An NMF App running under a Supervisor.
An NMF Supervisor managing a set of apps.
A self-contained NMF Monolithic provider not running under a Supervisor.
A Ground MO Proxy bridging the space and ground networks.

mal:composite.name: NearbyPositionAlert
mal:composite.comment: Alert state for spacecraft entering/exiting nearby position boundary.

mal:field.name: enteredBoundary
mal:field.comment: True if entering boundary, false if exiting.

mal:error.name: Invalid Argument
mal:error.comment: A field in the message contains an invalid value. If there are multiple errors, the first invalid field is reported.

mal:error.name: Duplicate
mal:error.comment: An attempt was made to create or store an object using an identifier that is already in use.
